_note: exports-switch-off-after-repeated-failure. An export job counts its failed runs in a row (ExportFailureSwitch::countRun, called from ExportJobService::recordRun when a run finishes). At the threshold (app config export_failure_threshold, 1 to 10, default 3) the job is switched off in the same save, with the reason and the moment. Switching the job on again clears all three. Version 1.2.0 adds optional fields only.

consecutiveFailures.title: Failed runs in a row
consecutiveFailures.description: Failed runs in a row since the last succeeded run. A partial run leaves it as it is.

pausedReason.title: Switched off because
pausedReason.description: Why the system switched the job off; empty for a job a person switched off.

pausedAt.title: Switched off at
pausedAt.description: When the system switched the job off.
